interpretation: Epoch 84 proved that a locally live-verified fast shift can miss execution and recover by natural hourly recurrence. Epoch 85 exposed a second scheduler edge case: an invocation can be observed before the still-pending verified fast due. Such a premature invocation must not overwrite the pending due with a new provisional or count as delivery success. The pending 08:29:51 KST due was restored before expiry, and a premature-wake fence was added.
next_action: Require future wakes to compare observed invocation time with the fresh pending verified due before BOOT_STARTED/provisional rearm/authority. Preserve exact 1-minute (60-second) local rearm. Only at/after-due generation-matched bootstrap may count toward P0-B fast delivery.
